required_probes.description: A transaction containing a valid synthetic write and a deliberately failing entry leaves no partial write.

A successful single-server transaction persists the synthetic target and Provenance together; the server's AuditEvent or documented immutable audit interface is independently observed and correlated to the exact committed transaction and resource version.
A stale version precondition is rejected and no dependent write is partially committed.
Two equivalent synthetic conditional creates do not create two logical resources.
A server-side authorization hook or equivalent commit-bound guard races revocation and prevents a release serialized after revocation; a pre-read alone does not pass.
A durable release intent, audit intent, and outbox record are committed together before external delivery begins.
After commit with a lost response, retry or lookup with the same operation key recovers the original result without repeating the external side effect.
Synthetic negative controls prove that changing actor, tenant, or patient binding cannot reuse the qualified transaction.

explicit_non_claims: CapabilityStatement declarations are not active proof of server behavior.
FHIR transaction atomicity is limited to the transaction boundary of one FHIR server.
A FHIR transaction does not create an atomic transaction across a separate consent registry, Holochain DHT, gateway, and remote recipient.
FHIR REST does not itself define authentication, authorization, or audit collection.
A successful probe does not prove a cryptographic signature unless the evidence artifact is independently verified.
An outbox does not prove exactly-once delivery to a remote system without remote idempotency and reconciliation.
This benchmark does not establish HIPAA compliance, clinical validation, or production readiness.

required_components.description: Exact Mycelix gateway adapter build and effective configuration used to execute FHIR operations.
Exact authenticated actor/token issuer and relevant key-set/configuration revision used by principal-binding probes.
Exact Consent/revocation/policy authority store build, schema and configuration used at commit.
Exact durable audit/outbox backend build, schema and configuration used for the atomic-intent and retry probes.
Exact isolated synthetic recipient endpoint/build used for response-loss and idempotency probes.
